subject: Global demo series — consolidating windows to avoid regional holidays
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@orchidfin.com>

Subject: Re: Coordinating global demo slots for Q1/Q2

Hi Mina — great to connect at the conference last week. Our engineering leadership is keen to see Redwood's dedicated inference flow for multi-region traffic.

We have three regional cohorts that need to attend: US product + infra (EST/PST), EU regional leads (CET), and APAC ops (IST/JST). Right now our thinking is a short global demo series so each region can get live Q&A with their timezone-aligned slot:
- US slot: Tue Jan 12, 10:00am EST
- EU slot: Wed Feb 2, 11:00am CET
- APAC slot: Thu May 6, 9:30am JST

Can Redwood run a consolidated demo cadence (same deck + breakout Q&A) or do you recommend a single global window to reduce duplicated effort? If a single global window is better, please propose times that avoid major regional holidays — our APAC lead called out a possible Golden Week overlap in early May and several folks around India will be OOO for a week in late Oct (Diwali).

Attached a quick attendee list and suggested agenda. Looking forward — Tom

Team — forwarding Tom's note. Key asks:
- Customer wants either three regional slots or a single consolidated global window that avoids holidays (Golden Week, Diwali, Easter for EU teams in spring).
- They prefer to have the same deck + breakout rooms for region-specific Q&A.

Can we:
1) propose a consolidated 90-minute global slot that we can run once (with recorded replays/backfills for those who can't attend), and
2) include an APAC-friendly follow-up slot if needed?

I've penciled in a few candidate windows in the attached .ics. Marcus — can you confirm runtime constraints if we do a single run (latency demo, live load test) vs. three separate regional runs?

Thanks, Mina

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Coordinating global demo slots for Q1/Q2

On the runtime side, a single 90-minute session is feasible but we need to tweak the live load portion:
- Suggest limiting live end-to-end throughput verification to a 15-minute focused window (we can pre-run a stress test and include results in the deck).
- Breakouts per region: 20 minutes each in parallel channels (we can capture logs/traces per token path).

For dates: avoid early May (Golden Week: late Apr–early May causes Japan attendance gaps) and avoid the first half of April due to several EU teams taking Easter week as PTO. Diwali is later in the year (Oct/Nov) so it only affects their Q4 calendar.

My recommendation: aim for a consolidated slot in mid-May after Golden Week (e.g., May 16) or the second week of June. That gives APAC folks time to return from holiday and EU teams will be out of Easter week. If they insist on separate regional runs, we can do three short runs in Jan/Feb/May but that increases SE time.

I attached an updated .ics with May 16 and Jun 10 options and the correlated infrastructure checklist for the live segment.

Attachment: global-demo-slots.ics
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@orchidfin.com>

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Coordinating global demo slots for Q1/Q2

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Mid-May sounds promising but our APAC director (Japan & India leads) flagged May 6–12 as a high-risk window because some regional offices stagger Golden Week observances and local partners will be partially OOO.

Could we shift the consolidated window to May 16 as Marcus suggested? That should dodge Golden Week tail and give EU teams time after their Easter PTO. A follow-up APAC-native slot the following week would be fine for anyone still unable to attend.

We prefer the single run with breakouts — reduces repeated briefings and gives execs one recording to review. Please confirm the final date and we'll lock attendees.

--
